config.ak_trade_expansion.title: AK Trade Expansion Settings
config.ak_trade_expansion.server_locked: Cannot be changed while connected to a server. Edit the server's config/ak_trade_expansion.json and run /aktradeex reload
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.ratio: How many copper coins one iron coin is worth. Decide it when creating the world (changing it changes the value of coins already held)
How many iron coins one gold coin is worth
How many gold coins one diamond coin is worth
How many diamond coins one netherite coin is worth
When on, a world keeps the ratios it was created with even if the setting changes
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.allow: Crafting recipe: 9 copper blocks → copper coins (iron blocks also need "Allow iron minting" below). Applies after a server restart or /reload
Crafting recipe: 9 iron blocks → iron coins. Off by default: iron golem farms give unlimited iron, i.e. unlimited money. Needs "Allow minting" too. Applies after a server restart or /reload
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.chang: Change (coins) dropped at your feet because the inventory is full can only be picked up by you. Off: anyone can pick it up
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.emera: Emerald coins sell at the same price everywhere (4c per 10) and selling does not lower it. Off: the price moves like other goods
Markets take any number of emerald coins (never stop buying). Off: they stop at the stock cap (640 coins)
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.hal: Points halve every this many in-game days (0 = never)
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.poi: Points per copper traded at the market (0.01 = 1 point per 100c)
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.sho: Trade points for selling a good the market is short of are multiplied by this
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.acc: Delivering a request you accepted multiplies its points by this
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.vil: Points per trade with a villager near the market
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.att: Points lost per hit on a villager or trader near the market
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.kil: Points lost for killing a villager or trader near the market
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.que: Points lost per star when an accepted request expires undelivered
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.pri: Buy cheaper / sell higher by this per level (0.01 = 1%; capped per good)
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.rew: Request rewards higher by this per level
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.har: Level needed to deliver 3-star requests (0 = anyone)
config.ak_trade_expansion.reputation.spe: Level from which the reputation specials are shown
Extra specials shown only to players with a good reputation
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.excha: Fee ratio of the exchange tab
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.start: Copper given the first time a player joins the world (into the wallet if any, otherwise as coins). 240c = 10 loaves of bread. 0 = none
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.mobDr: Hostile mobs killed by a player drop a few coins
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.sneak: Sneak + use breaks one coin into the next smaller coins
config.ak_trade_expansion.currency.emera: Coins the stonecutter makes from one emerald block. 0 disables the recipe. Applies after a restart or /reload
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.defaultS: Gap between buy and sell prices (default when a good does not set it). Changes existing prices immediately
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.defaultE: Larger = prices move less per trade (default when a good does not set it)
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.minMulti: Prices never drop below this share of the base price
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.maxMulti: Prices never rise above this multiple of the base price
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.jitter.d: Random spread of base prices in new markets (existing markets keep theirs)
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.defaultM: Stock cap = target stock × this, when a good does not set it
config.ak_trade_expansion.price.globalMu: Multiplies every price. Changes existing prices immediately
config.ak_trade_expansion.recovery.halfL: In-game days until a price deviation is halved
config.ak_trade_expansion.recovery.clock: GAME_TIME: sleeping does not count / DAY_TIME: sleeping counts. Switching may shift recovery once
config.ak_trade_expansion.distance.merge: Stalls within this distance share one market
config.ak_trade_expansion.distance.nearR: Markets within this distance share price changes 100%
config.ak_trade_expansion.distance.farRa: Markets farther than this are not affected
config.ak_trade_expansion.distance.fallo: 1 = linear, 2 = drops quickly just outside the near radius
config.ak_trade_expansion.distance.linkN: Nether coordinates ×8 count as Overworld coordinates, so nearby markets in both dimensions share price movements (only goods both deal in)
config.ak_trade_expansion.distance.minNe: A crafted stall may found a new market only this far from existing markets
config.ak_trade_expansion.market.levelTh: Beds around the market needed for level 2
config.ak_trade_expansion.market.village: This many villagers around the market give level 2. The Nether and the End use villagers only; in the Overworld, with "Level also counts villagers" on, the lower of the bed level and the villager level is used
config.ak_trade_expansion.market.levelUs: Overworld market level = the lower of the bed level and the villager level (both are needed to level up). Off: beds only
config.ak_trade_expansion.market.levelRa: Beds / villagers within this horizontal distance are counted
config.ak_trade_expansion.market.levelCh: Opening the screen re-measures the level after this many in-game days
config.ak_trade_expansion.wallet.autoCol: Coins go into the wallet automatically while you carry one
config.ak_trade_expansion.bank.minMarket: Markets of at least this level show the bank tab
config.ak_trade_expansion.bank.interestM: Interest is paid on the balance up to this amount (none on the rest). 0 = no cap
config.ak_trade_expansion.bank.interestR: Interest on bank deposits per in-game day (0.0003 = 0.03%, about 0.3% in 10 days). Compounded daily, worked out when the account is used. 0 = none
config.ak_trade_expansion.bank.cardFee.d: Fee to issue or reissue a card (c)
config.ak_trade_expansion.trade.maxDista: You must be this close to the stall to trade
config.ak_trade_expansion.trade.acceptDa: Buy damaged items at a price reduced by durability
config.ak_trade_expansion.trade.priceTol: Cancel when the price moved more than this ratio from the preview. 0 = any change cancels
config.ak_trade_expansion.trade.allowShi: Shift trades the largest possible quantity
config.ak_trade_expansion.trade.allowCre: Let creative-mode players trade (off by default: infinite items break the economy)
config.ak_trade_expansion.worldgen.spawn: Place stalls in newly generated villages. Applies after the server (world) restarts
config.ak_trade_expansion.worldgen.prote: Naturally generated stalls cannot be broken
config.ak_trade_expansion.worldgen.spawn: Place a trader NPC in front of stalls
config.ak_trade_expansion.log.trades.des: Write every trade to the server log
config.ak_trade_expansion.command.permis: Permission needed for /aktradeex admin subcommands (2 = op)
config.ak_trade_expansion.client.showDeb: Hovering a good on the trade screen shows its base price, current multiplier, stock and how long prices and stock take to recover
tooltip.ak_trade_expansion.wallet_hint: Stack coins onto it to store them. Use to take coins out
screen.ak_trade_expansion.bank.issue_car: Issue a card (fee %s, from the account)
bank.ak_trade_expansion.result.creative_: The bank is not available in Creative mode

screen.ak_trade_expansion.board.header.b: Buy: what you pay there for one
screen.ak_trade_expansion.board.header.s: Sell: what you get there for one

config.ak_trade_expansion.board.radius.d: Horizontal distance of markets listed on the board tab
config.ak_trade_expansion.board.maxMarke: Lists up to this many markets, nearest first
config.ak_trade_expansion.quest.maxPerMa: Maximum open requests per market. 0 = none
config.ak_trade_expansion.quest.refreshD: New requests fill empty slots this often
config.ak_trade_expansion.quest.duration: Requests expire after this many days
config.ak_trade_expansion.quest.rewardMu: Reward = total base price of the items × this
config.ak_trade_expansion.quest.difficul: Requests worth at least this (base prices) are ★2
config.ak_trade_expansion.quest.transpor: Most transport requests (carry a crate to another market) per market, counted apart from the other requests. 0 = none

config.ak_trade_expansion.demand.maxShor: Maximum goods in shortage at once. 0 = off
config.ak_trade_expansion.demand.duratio: Shortage goods are re-chosen this often
config.ak_trade_expansion.demand.minMult: Range of the base price multiplier of goods in shortage
config.ak_trade_expansion.trader.spawnOn: Spawn a trader NPC near the stall when it is opened
config.ak_trade_expansion.villager.coinT: Buying from villagers is paid in coins from wallets and coins instead of emeralds
config.ak_trade_expansion.villager.emera: Conversion used when villager trades use coins
config.ak_trade_expansion.recovery.consu: Consumables (food, torches, fuel, logs etc., tag #ak_trade_expansion:consumables) above the target stock are used up at target stock × this per day. 1.0 = back to the target within a day, so the market buys again

config.ak_trade_expansion.villager.wande: While villager coin trades are on, buying from the wandering trader is paid in coins too
command.ak_trade_expansion.audit_village: %s villagers / wandering traders nearby, %s coin trades, %s of them profit when resold at a market (largest first, up to 15)

screen.ak_trade_expansion.board.deal_hin: Hover a market to see its deals (B: goods cheaper to buy than here, S: goods that sell for more)
config.ak_trade_expansion.board.dealThre: The board marks goods at least this much cheaper to buy, or paying this much more, than at the current market (or the standard price) as deals. 0.1 = 10%
screen.ak_trade_expansion.town.how: Grows with requests, donations and trades; building spends it
screen.ak_trade_expansion.town.marker_gi: You received a building site stake
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.en: Requests, donations and trades raise the development of a village, which builds facilities. Off: no Town tab and no points (facilities already built keep working)
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.di: Ids of the dimensions whose markets can develop, separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:overworld, minecraft:the_nether
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.ma: Donating materials the village wants gives base price × count × this
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.qu: A delivered request adds this share of its reward as development points (transport requests: to both markets)
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.tr: Development points per copper bought or sold at the market
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.ha: Development points halve over this many in-game days. 0 = they never decrease
config.ak_trade_expansion.development.re: Reputation points with the village per development point donated

config.ak_trade_expansion.development.ma: Facilities a market may have under construction at the same time

config.ak_trade_expansion.development.in: Villagers who arrive when an inn is completed for the first time
